text:
maya: Heads-up: hitting inconsistent exception behavior from the Python SDK while wiring up a sample async app. Sometimes a 401 comes through as AuthError, sometimes as APIError. Also 422 validation payloads arrive as raw bytes in a few cases.
aaron: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro?
maya: async snippet:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ValidationError, AuthError
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='...')
try:
    await client.chat.create(prompt='x')
except ValidationError as e:
    print('fields=', e.errors)
except AuthError:
    print('auth failure')
```
maya: in practice `AuthError` import fails in mypy (not exported in stubs) and at runtime the 401 was caught as APIError. For the 422s I get `APIError: 422 - b"{\"detail\": \"bad\"}"` with no parsed structure.
dani: this sounds like two problems: runtime wrapping in the async transport + incomplete typeshed exports. our examples show `ValidationError` and `AuthError` but the refactor removed them from the pyi.
ia-bot: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/725 (py-sdk: inconsistent exception classes and error parsing)
aaron: suggested fixes: 1) unify transport error handling so both sync and async map specific status codes to concrete subclasses (AuthError, ValidationError) that subclass APIError; 2) always attempt json.loads on error bodies (try/except) regardless of content-type header; 3) normalize known shapes: if parsed has "detail" or "errors", map to ValidationError.errors as a list of dicts; 4) attach raw_body (bytes) and parsed_body (optional[dict]) to APIError for debugging.
dani: add types: update errors.pyi to export APIError, AuthError, ValidationError and annotate ValidationError.errors: List[Dict[str, str]]; export them in package __all__ so `from redwood.errors import AuthError` typechecks.
aaron: also add APIError.is_retryable() helper that returns True for 5xx and network timeouts so callers can implement backoff without ad-hoc status checks.
maya: small DX ask: include both sync and async snippets showing `except ValidationError as e:` and how to inspect `e.parsed_body` vs `e.raw_body`. new users keep copying examples that assume a plaintext message.
dani: plan: runtime change + types + tests + quickstart update. will keep APIError base for compatibility. We'll add migration note in changelog: "Exceptions: concrete subclasses exported; ValidationError now includes .errors and .raw_body".
aaron: will open PR, include unit tests for sync+async, mypy check, and a short example in docs. target next patch.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/703 (normalize error parsing; export exceptions in types)
maya: verified locally against sample async app: 401 raises AuthError and 422 yields ValidationError with errors list. grateful!
dani: assigning @aaron. leaving open until CI green.
ci-bot: linked issue #725 and added milestone "0.14.1"
maya: thanks team :rocket:
